ITEM 1 | Browned meat pieces with pink-red interior, irregular chunks about 3-4 cm across, slightly glossy surface with dark seared edges, sitting on the left side of the plate with some rice-like grains stuck to the surfaces | 130
ITEM 2 | Smaller browned meat chunk, pink-red center with darker seared exterior, about 2-3 cm, stacked against the larger piece in the lower-middle of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Grains of cooked rice-like starch, pale tan with darker flecks, scattered and clinging over and between the meat pieces, matte and loose, small amount | 25
ITEM 4 | Bright green broccoli florets, about 2-3 cm across each, firm with slightly darker tips, arranged in a cluster on the right side of the plate, some stems visible, a few with light char or dry edges | 110
ITEM 5 | Thin reddish-purple stem or stalk pieces, fine and about 4-5 cm long, lying across the bottom edge of the meat pieces | 3
